storageAccountName.comment: Globally unique storage account name using 3-24 lowercase alphanumeric characters.

openAiAccountName.comment: Azure OpenAI resource name. Availability depends on subscription and region.

embeddingDeploymentName.comment: Azure OpenAI embedding deployment name used by the Functions application.

functionAppName.comment: Globally unique Azure Function App name.

searchServiceName.comment: Globally unique Azure AI Search service name.

replicaCount.comment: Number of Azure AI Search replicas.

partitionCount.comment: Number of Azure AI Search partitions.

logicAppName.comment: Logic App name used for scheduled NewsAPI ingestion.

apimName.comment: Globally unique Azure API Management instance name.

publisherEmail.comment: Replace with the email address used for the APIM publisher profile.

publisherName.comment: Publisher or organization name displayed by API Management.

purviewAccountName.comment: Globally unique Microsoft Purview account name.

ingestCategories.comment: Comma-separated NewsAPI categories consumed by the ingestion workflow.

tenantId.comment: Azure Entra ID tenant ID used by the APIM JWT validation policy.

apiAppIdUri.comment: Application ID URI used as the expected JWT audience by APIM.

bronzeContainerName.comment: Bronze storage container used for raw NewsAPI article data.

searchIndexName.comment: Azure AI Search index name used by the Functions application.

secretsComment.value: SECRETS NOT STORED IN THIS FILE
secretsComment.comment: Secure values should be supplied during deployment or through an appropriate secret-management mechanism. Do not commit API keys or connection strings to source control.
